_comment: Mirrors /etc/waybeam-link/ground.json on the ground at 192.168.2.242, read from the node 2026-08-09. SINGLE 8812AU on bus 5-1 as the TX/RX combo (operator rule) - RadioAir's role:'tx' adapter is duplex and also receives, so no second adapter is paired for the ground role; the 8812CU diversity entry this file used to carry is gone. Bus was 8-1 in the previous revision and nothing is there now: USB bus paths shuffle on re-plug, so the path is measured (lsusb -t), never carried over. Devourer (air.kind radio); whole-frame SHM egress.

adapters._power_comment: §10.5 offset space. 8812AU uplink floor MEASURED at the craft 2026-08-16: 0/-24/-48/-72 qdb read -45/-50/-56/-63 dBm (exactly 0.25 dB/qdB), -96 reports saturated_low true and -128 clamps to -126. 18 dB of travel; the ladder's existing bottom rung IS the floor. The ground's own receive RSSI held -56 throughout — the control that says only its TX moved. BENCH-LOW for 50 cm geometry — raise before any range or flight test.
adapters.name: au-uplink

streams._conceal_comment: §6.3b freeze/salvage option — parity knob for the freeze on/off A/B on either ground decoder backend (x86 vah265dec here; the rk3566 ground carries the same key in its on-device link config). 'off' = pre-§6.3b behaviour bit-for-bit; flip mode to 'slice-skip' to arm.
